name: llm-router
description: AI model routing — Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, NVIDIA Nematron via OpenRouter

models.description: Deep analysis, complex reasoning, strategic planning, contract review
General tasks, content writing, summaries, code generation

Multi-agent orchestration, persistent agent brain, high-throughput agentic tasks. 120B params / 12B active (MoE). 1M context window. 85.6% PunchBench. 5x faster than previous gen. Ideal for 24/7 agent loops and multi-step workflows
Vision tasks, creative content, image analysis, design review
Fast responses, bulk processing, document extraction. 1M context for large PDFs
Quick lightweight tasks, intent classification, routing decisions, edge deployment

routing_rules.agentic_routing_note: Use Nematron 3 Super for persistent agent loops, multi-agent workflows, and 24/7 automation. Its MoE architecture (12B active / 120B total) provides enterprise-grade intelligence at lightweight cost. Use Claude Opus for deep analysis requiring nuance. Use Claude Sonnet as default for general tasks.

nemoclaw.description: NVIDIA enterprise-grade AI agent platform — open source, hardware agnostic, security-first
nemoclaw.note: NemoClaw is the enterprise alternative to OpenClaw — designed for production deployments with security controls. Hardware agnostic (runs on AMD, Intel, NVIDIA).

openclaw.description: Open-source AI agent framework — personal automation, 250K+ GitHub stars
openclaw.security_note: Not recommended for enterprise use — known security vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-25253). Use NemoClaw for production.
